name: silicon-220nm
description: A generic 220 nm silicon-on-insulator photonics process, TE. Representative of the open multi-project-wafer offerings (IMEC iSiPP, AMF, SiEPIC) rather than any one of them; every number is from published literature, and none is from a foundry's confidential kit. Use it to see what a PDK does, then replace it with yours. The fits are first-order over the C band and are refused outside 1500-1600 nm: run this coupler out to the O band and it returns a negative power fraction.

wg_strip.doc: The default routing waveguide. 500 x 220 nm, single mode at TE.

wg_rib.doc: Shallow-etched rib. Four times lower loss than strip, and a bend radius to match.

wg_nitride.doc: Silicon nitride: 0.1 dB/cm, no two-photon absorption, and a far weaker confinement.

dc_3db.doc: Nominal 3 dB coupler. Measures 0.48 at 1550 and drifts hard with wavelength — which is the reason the MMI beside it exists.

dc_10.doc: A 10 % tap, for monitoring a line without spending it.

mmi_2x2.doc: 2 x 2 general-interference MMI. Flat where the directional coupler is not; pays for it in excess loss.

mmi_1x4.doc: A 4-way splitter tree in one device.

mzi_switch.doc: Balanced thermo-optic switch. Set phase_shift to steer; a 220 nm strip heater reaches pi in roughly 20 mW.

mzi_interleaver_100g.doc: Unbalanced MZI on a 100 GHz grid: dL = c / (n_g * FSR) = 714 um at n_g 4.20.

ring_addrop_10um.doc: A 10 um radius add-drop ring — the parameter is the round trip, 2*pi*r = 62.83 um — near critical coupling on this loss.

ring_notch_nitride.doc: All-pass nitride ring, 40 um radius. Twenty times lower loss than silicon, so a far narrower linewidth at the same size.
